meaning:
πρώιος (Rec. -ϊος), -α, -ον
(πρωί), [in LXX for בֹּקֶר בַּ לַּ ;]
at early morn, early; as subst., ἡ π. (sc. ὥρα, cf. ἡ ὥ. ἡ π., 3Ma.5:24), early morning: Mat.27:1, Jhn.21:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
